name: Pit Crew
tagline: Tunes up the computer your bots run on: frees memory and disk, keeps updates flowing.
description: When the machine your bots share starts running hot on memory or storage, this one steps in and takes the pressure off before work grinds to a halt. It also guards the slim update route - keeping git and plugin fetches healthy - so marketplace and skill updates keep arriving on time.
author: scottxmetcalf
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
